text: Consent [Lat. con- + sentire , to feel]: Ger. Einwilligung ; Fr. consentement ; Ital. consenso . The volition to allow something to take place. I consent to an action; I assent to a proposition; a distinction involving that between belief and will. Cf. BELIEF. ( G.F.S. - J.M.B. )
